task: Adversarial review of SBG v2 novelty and experimental validity
summary: SBG v2 is conditionally novel if it enforces SAFEGUARD-1 (pre-registration) and SAFEGUARD-2 (output-free features). The structural-semantic inversion is a genuinely undocumented phenomenon. Three P0 risks must be resolved before experiments begin.

p0_risks.title: Post-hoc hypothesis formulation
p0_risks.description: H7-H12 were formulated after observing v1 results (inversion delta=0.0335, SBG AUROC=0.4237). A reviewer will ask: were these hypotheses written before or after you saw the v1 data? If after, they are exploratory results framed as confirmatory tests.
p0_risks.mitigation_required: SAFEGUARD-1: Commit H7-H12 to git with timestamp BEFORE any dynamic execution begins. The git commit hash provides verifiable evidence that hypotheses preceded results. H7-H12 must be explicitly labeled 'post-hoc motivated by v1, evaluated on held-out data' in any paper.

p0_risks.title: Benchmark gaming via output comparison
p0_risks.description: If v2 dynamic features include program output values (return values, stdout content), the evaluation trivially encodes ground truth: semantics-changing programs produce different outputs by definition. This reduces SBG v2 to differential testing (McKeeman 1998), not a behavioral genome. High AUROC from output comparison is scientifically meaningless for the genome claim.
p0_risks.mitigation_required: SAFEGUARD-2: Classify every v2 dynamic feature as Output-free (admissible) vs Output-proximate (differential testing only) BEFORE any feature engineering. SBG claims must use only Output-free features. Output-proximate features may exist in a separate B09_differential_testing baseline.

p0_risks.title: Circular evaluation via output-proximate features
p0_risks.description: If output-proximate features contaminate the SBG genome, the evaluation is circular: the genome is measuring the ground truth (behavioral equivalence is defined by output equivalence). Claiming SBG v2 outperforms v1 by including output comparison is not a scientific advance over differential testing.
p0_risks.mitigation_required: Architectural separation: DynamicGenome uses only Output-free features. A separate B09 baseline uses output comparison. Never mix in experimental results.

p1_risks.title: Missing prior art: execution-based clone detection
p1_risks.description: Jiang & Su (ISSTA 2009) 'Automatic Mining of Functionally Equivalent Code Fragments via Random Testing' detects code clones using execution I/O comparison. This is directly relevant to v2 and is missing from the prior art matrix. v2 must precisely differentiate from this work.
p1_risks.mitigation: Add to PRIOR_ART_MATRIX.md. Delta: Jiang & Su use output comparison (differential testing); SBG v2 uses output-FREE structural execution features (call patterns, branch coverage).

p1_risks.title: Intra-version noise may exceed inter-version signal
p1_risks.description: Programs using time.sleep, id(), datetime.now(), or threading produce non-deterministic traces. If intra-version std exceeds inter-version signal delta, dynamic features are noise, not signal.
p1_risks.mitigation: SAFEGUARD-6: Run genome extraction >=5 times per program. Measure intra-version variance. Exclude features where intra-version std > inter-version signal (10% threshold).

p1_risks.title: Multiple comparisons inflate false positive rate
p1_risks.description: Testing 12 hypotheses (H1-H12) without correction gives ~46% familywise false positive rate at alpha=0.05. Claiming any hypothesis is 'SUPPORTED' without correction is methodologically unsound.
p1_risks.mitigation: SAFEGUARD-7: Holm-Bonferroni across full family H1-H12 (n=12). alpha_corrected = 0.0042. Report both uncorrected and Holm-corrected p-values.

p2_risks.title: Small cross-language sample (n=15) insufficient for power
p2_risks.description: V1 had 15 cross-language pairs. At Bonferroni-corrected alpha=0.0042, power for medium effect (d=0.3) is approximately 25%. H11 cross-language result will be inconclusive by design.
p2_risks.mitigation: Explicitly label H11 as PILOT/EXPLORATORY. Report power calculation. Do not claim H11 is 'SUPPORTED' even if directionally positive with low p.

p2_risks.title: Hot-path signature uses function names (v1 flaw)
p2_risks.description: V1 hot_path_signature = SHA-256(function names) — invalidated by SP-2 (rename). If v2 carries this feature forward, SP-2 transforms will appear behaviorally different despite identical execution structure.
p2_risks.mitigation: V2 replaces name-based hot path with rank-based call frequency vector (anon_call_freq). Names used only for counting, not as features.

p3_risks.title: SP-8 divergence bug creates false EQUIVALENT labels
p3_risks.description: Agent 0H documented that SP-8 (extract function) has real behavioral divergence in some corpus programs, producing mislabeled EQUIVALENT pairs. This affects H10 (refactoring robustness) specifically.
p3_risks.mitigation: Exclude SP-8 pairs from H10 analysis. Document as data quality limitation.

novelty_verdict.gap: Structural-semantic inversion is not documented, named, or quantified in prior literature. This is the organizing scientific contribution of SBG v1+v2.
novelty_verdict.v2_contribution: V2 quantifies whether dynamic execution evidence overcomes the inversion. This is the specific research question that is novel.
novelty_verdict.delta_over_b06: B06 (v1 dynamic, AUROC=0.5046) uses raw execution trace comparison with degenerate threshold. V2 SBG uses structured behavioral genome dimensions (anonymized call frequency, coverage consistency, exception type sets) — a structural abstraction over raw traces.
novelty_verdict.delta_over_jiang_su: Jiang & Su use output comparison (differential testing). V2 SBG uses output-FREE structural execution features — the genome claim requires this distinction.

recommendation: CONDITIONAL_PASS — proceed to Phase 1 ONLY after SAFEGUARD-1 (pre-registration of H7-H12) is committed to git. Do not run any dynamic execution before that commit exists.
assumptions: H7-H12 will be evaluated on the same held-out test split as H1-H6 (no new contamination)
Feature oracle audit (SAFEGUARD-2) will happen before any experiment runs
v2 dynamic genome will NOT include return values or stdout content
unresolved_issues: Need git commit hash as evidence for SAFEGUARD-1 timestamp
